first_principles_hypothesis: Region completion requires a query-independent estimate that two canonical regions belong to one physical-semantic instance. Geometry and distilled typed context alone do not transfer this relation reliably. Official DINO appearance direction and SAM boundary direction provide complementary identity and boundary evidence; their concentration values expose when either cosine is unreliable. A bounded nonlinear relation can express these conjunctions without allowing sparse false-positive bridges to percolate globally.

canonical_axis.evidence: The preregistered source primitive oracle obtained K<=8 IoU 0.42563 on AcceptedV2 versus 0.44706 on the dense axis; the 0.02143 gain is below the frozen 0.05 dense-inference trigger.

pair_features.base: the fixed 15 symmetric RegionCoMembershipV1 channels in their original order
pair_features.candidate_pairs: the exact sorted unique V1 candidate pairs; capability descriptors do not create additional candidates

model.normalization: per-channel median and 1.4826*MAD fitted on positive-evidence source-train pair rows only, with zero MAD replaced by one

training.objective: equal-scene mean of within-scene evidence-weighted BCE with equal positive and negative class means

readout.seed: every source-validation region with positive primitive-instance evidence during source selection; target seed remains the unique highest frozen O0 region with lowest-canonical-index tie break
readout.global_rule: one method_one_K_one_threshold shared by every scene_instance_and_query

primitive_instance_metric.selection_unit: deduplicated union of primitive rows in the selected canonical region cores
primitive_instance_metric.source_authority: exact sparse-marginal primitive-by-instance mass from source training views
primitive_instance_metric.target_instance_for_seed: the positive instance with maximum exact mass in the seed region core; ties use lowest positive instance ID
primitive_instance_metric.selected_mass: sum each primitive-by-instance mass cell once after primitive-row deduplication; instance zero contributes false-positive selected mass but never defines an eligible target
primitive_instance_metric.aggregation: seed-target-mass weighted within each instance_then_equal-instance macro_then_equal-scene macro

joint_selection.checkpoint_and_readout: maximize source-validation equal-scene topology score jointly over epoch_method_K_threshold
